column1: # Runs where the agent read or ran the hidden tests baked into the image (/opt/harness).
# Found 2026-10-15 from each run's Claude Code transcript; images fixed the same day.
# audit_results.py excludes these from per-model verdicts.

column7: Bash: find /opt/harness -type f | head -50; echo ===; wc -l /opt/harness/s3test/s3test.go /opt/harness/authproxy/main.go /opt/harness/security/security_test.go
Bash: cat /opt/harness/Cargo.toml; echo "=== nextest"; cat /opt/harness/.config/nextest.toml; echo "=== tests dir"; ls -la /opt/harness/tests/
